//: Starting point for a sky130 digital block. Every value here is a
//2: deliberate choice, not a default: read the comments before copying.
//rtl: dir:: resolves against this config file, so the run works from anywhere

//synth: AREA 0 is a reasonable default; change strategy only after the design closes once
